observations.observation: IHMEC's release said the three named VR films were available free on Quest 3/3S as of October 8, while Pico 4 Ultra and Samsung Galaxy AndroidXR versions were planned for later in the fall. It described the prior access channels as museum venues and a traveling Mobile VR Trunk.
observations.event_time: 2026-10-08 (release says available that day; exact app-live time not specified)
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The source is the issuer's announcement and independently verifies neither the exact store-live time nor actual downloads. The rollout to other named platforms was prospective.

observations.observation: Samsung's preliminary Q3 guidance was publicly timestamped at 07:00 BST on October 8, before the cutoff. It estimated KRW 195 trillion in sales and KRW 107.4 trillion in operating profit.
observations.counterpoint_or_limit: The figures were preliminary, before external audit; the guidance did not provide a business-division breakdown and does not connect the museum announcement to Micron.

gaps: No independent, time-verified report of the museum release before the cutoff was established. The same-day XRMust article has only a date and largely repeats the announcement.
The release's statement of current Quest availability was not independently confirmed by a store listing or other timestamped source available by the cutoff.
No separate pre-launch expectation or dated pre-cutoff snapshot was verified; the prior-access baseline comes from the release's own description.
The Yonhap page surfaced as a recast with an 08:14 timestamp, but no pre-cutoff archived version or initial dispatch time was verified; its added context was therefore not used.
research_notes: Research-only; cutoff is 2026-10-08T14:04:40.055895Z. The earliest traceable public source found for the subject announcement is the IHMEC release on GlobeNewswire at 10:00 ET (14:00Z), about 4 minutes 40 seconds before cutoff. Its stated prior context is that access had been limited to museum venues and the traveling Mobile VR Trunk; the new information is free Quest 3/3S access, with Pico and Samsung Galaxy AndroidXR compatibility deferred to later in the fall. This is a staged distribution expansion, not evidence of a new film or a Micron business development. The release itself contains no MU-specific facts; that is an inference from its text, not proof against any indirect connection. Supplied W2 likewise lists no matched conditions or policies. A contemporaneous Samsung preliminary earnings guidance is included as separate memory-sector context, not as a link to the museum announcement or Micron. No post-cutoff market reaction or later outcome is used.
